import gzip,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from nisayon.engine.io import file_digest
out=Path('docs/experiments/results/confirmation-engine-001')
manifest=json.loads((out/'retained-output-manifest.json').read_text())
for item in manifest['outputs']:
 assert file_digest(out/item['path'])==item['sha256'],item['path']
 if item.get('uncompressed_sha256'):
  import hashlib
  assert hashlib.sha256(gzip.decompress((out/item['path']).read_bytes())).hexdigest()==item['uncompressed_sha256']
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','db9eae2','--','src','tests','scripts','pyproject.toml','uv.lock','Makefile']).strip()
for row in subprocess.check_output(['git','log','14e7805..HEAD','--format=%an|%ae|%cn|%ce'],text=True).splitlines():
 assert row=='Daniel Wahnich|cogitoergosum143@gmail.com|Daniel Wahnich|cogitoergosum143@gmail.com',row
messages=subprocess.check_output(['git','log','14e7805..HEAD','--format=%B'],text=True).lower()
assert 'co-authored-by:' not in messages and 'generated-by:' not in messages
print({'retained_outputs_verified':len(manifest['outputs']),'application_unchanged_from_full_check':True,'attribution_verified':True})
